# XFree.in — Free Online Developer, SEO, AI & Converter Micro-Tools Suite

> XFree.in provides free online, browser-based developer tools, technical SEO utilities, single-purpose AI assistants, code formatters, and data converters with browser-based execution for local tools.

## Primary Sections & Hubs

- [Home Page](https://www.xfree.in/): Complete registry search and grid view of indexable micro-tools.
- [Guides](https://www.xfree.in/guides): Practical documentation connected to published tools.

## Categories

- [SEO & URL Tools](https://www.xfree.in/category/seo-tools): Bulk extraction, XML sitemaps, Meta OpenGraph previews, Robots.txt, and Schema markup
- [Developer Tools](https://www.xfree.in/category/developer-tools): Format, validate, diff, and convert JSON, XML, YAML, Regex, Cron, JWT, and SQL
- [Converters & Encoders](https://www.xfree.in/category/converters): Base64, URL encoding, Unix Timestamps, Color space conversion, and CSS units
- [Generators](https://www.xfree.in/category/generators): UUID v4, Cron schedules, Hash generation (SHA-256/MD5), and UTM campaign links

## Core API Endpoints for Developers & AI Agents

- `POST /api/ai`: Single-purpose AI proxy (ai-regex, ai-json-repair, ai-meta-optimizer, ai-sql-generator, ai-search-intent, ai-code-explainer, ai-commit-generator, ai-schema-generator).
- `POST /api/ai/batch`: Batch processing endpoint for bulk CSV/TXT items.
- `POST /api/ai/thinking`: Deep reasoning endpoint powered by Google Gemini reasoning model (configurable via GEMINI_THINKING_MODEL) with high thinking budget.
- `POST /api/ai/chat`: Multi-turn conversational developer AI assistant.

## Complete Index of Indexable Micro-Tools

- [XML Sitemap Generator & Validator](https://www.xfree.in/tools/xml-sitemap-generator): Generate valid Google & Bing XML sitemaps with priority, changefreq, lastmod, and automatic chunking for large link sets. (Pillar: XML Sitemap Generator)
- [Robots.txt Generator & User-Agent Rule Tester](https://www.xfree.in/tools/robots-txt-generator): Create valid robots.txt directives for search engine crawlers, test path allowance rules, and specify XML sitemaps. (Pillar: Robots.txt Generator)
- [Meta Tag & Open Graph Social Card Preview](https://www.xfree.in/tools/meta-tag-generator): Generate meta title tags, meta descriptions, and Open Graph / Twitter Cards with real-time Google SERP and social card previews. (Pillar: Meta Tag Generator)
- [Schema Markup Generator (JSON-LD Structured Data)](https://www.xfree.in/tools/schema-markup-generator): Generate valid Schema.org JSON-LD structured data for WebSite, Organization, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, Article, and Breadcrumbs. (Pillar: Schema Markup Generator)
- [JSON / XML Formatter, Validator & Tree Viewer](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-formatter): Format, validate, repair, minify, and inspect JSON/XML data with interactive tree views and error location diagnostics. (Pillar: JSON Formatter and Validator)
- [Regex Tester & Interactive Match Explainer](https://www.xfree.in/tools/regex-tester): Test regular expressions live with match group breakdown, string replacement previews, and flags (g, i, m). (Pillar: Regex Tester)
- [Bulk URL Extractor & Sitemap Generator](https://www.xfree.in/tools/bulk-url-extractor): Extract URLs from massive raw text or HTML, clean, deduplicate, filter by domain, and generate valid XML Sitemaps with Sitemap-Index splitting. (Pillar: Free Bulk URL Extractor & Sitemap Generator Online)
- [Cron Expression Generator & Human Translator](https://www.xfree.in/tools/cron-expression-generator): Generate standard 5-part cron schedule expressions, view plain-English explanations, and calculate upcoming execution times. (Pillar: Cron Expression Generator)
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder & JWT Token Inspector](https://www.xfree.in/tools/base64-encoder-decoder): Safely encode and decode Base64 strings, UTF-8 text, Base64URL parameters, and inspect OAuth JWT headers, payloads, and claims. (Pillar: Base64 & JWT Decoder)
- [URL Slug Generator & Campaign UTM Parameter Builder](https://www.xfree.in/tools/url-slug-utm-builder): Clean title strings into SEO-friendly URL slugs, and build campaign URLs with UTM parameters (source, medium, campaign, term, content). (Pillar: URL Slug Generator)
